title: Bintulu Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Bintulu Marathon 2026 review: 10,472 runners from 23 countries on 2 August, a Kenyan marathon win, and a race-pack collection that ran badly late.
dek: Bintulu's development authority put on one of Sarawak's biggest races on 2 August 2026, with 10,472 runners. Here is what it was like, including the part that went wrong.
verdict: The Bintulu Marathon is a big town-hosted race backed by the Bintulu Development Authority (BDA). The 2026 edition, on 2 August, drew 10,472 runners, 461 of them from 22 other countries [1], across a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 6 km [1]. Edwin Yebei Kiptoo won the men's marathon in 2:41:35 [1]. The organisers added Sarawak-themed shirts and medals, eco-friendly goodie bags and finisher discounts at local coffee shops [1]. They also apologised for long delays at race-pack collection on its busiest day, caused by a system fault and traffic jams [1]. If you enter next year, collect your pack early.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The race drew 10,472 participants: 10,011 Malaysians and 461 runners from 22 countries [1]. They ranged from six to 81 years old, with the 31 to 40 age group the largest at 4,279 runners [1].
There were four main categories, 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 6 km, each split by age and gender [1]. BDA said the competitive 42 km, 21 km and 10 km all had more entries than before [1].

sections.heading: Results and Extras
paragraphs: Edwin Yebei Kiptoo won the men's open marathon in 2:41:35, ahead of Muhamad Haziq Hamzah and Syahrullah Safri, and Nur Fatin Syuhada Tamsi won the women's open marathon [1]. Andy Yeo Jia Wei and Hui Khiing Yu won the open half marathons [1].

The race shirt and medal were designed around Sarawak's identity and culture, goodie bags were plastic-free, and a number of Bintulu coffee shops and restaurants gave 10% off to anyone showing a finisher medal [1].

sections.heading: The Race-Pack Problem
paragraphs: Race-pack collection did not go smoothly. BDA apologised for long delays on the busiest collection day, which it blamed on an unexpected technical fault in its system and traffic congestion around the venue [1].

More than 4,000 runners still collected their packs that day, and the process finished at about 4pm [1]. BDA said it would review the layout, traffic flow, network system and venue choice for future editions [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a large race in Sarawak with a local flavour, yes. Ten thousand runners, a real international field and a town that rewards finishers make it more than a local fun run.
Plan around the pack collection. Go on a quieter day if you can, and allow time for traffic until the organisers show they have fixed the 2026 problems.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Who won the Bintulu Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: Edwin Yebei Kiptoo won the men's open marathon in 2:41:35 and Nur Fatin Syuhada Tamsi the women's open marathon. Andy Yeo Jia Wei and Hui Khiing Yu won the open half marathons.
